item.title: Jagannath
item.description: This is my take on चक्र नेत्र जगत नाथ Circle maneuver flow (चक्र) + connect pull place (नेत्र) + wide move float (जगत) + pull till platform (नाथ).

item.title: अन्त
item.description: अन्त = अ न त Here pull float here pull that this pull float this pull that (as place holder) Comments I believe आदि अन्त are to be interpreted as वर्ण समास and not as पद.
